mapper.sql:
WITH member_scores AS ( SELECT cm.member_id, cm.user_id,
COALESCE(cmr.mission_completion_count, 0) AS mission_completion_count, cmr.created_at AS updated_at
COALESCE(cms.total_mission_count, 0) AS mission_completion_count, cms.updated_at AS updated_at
FROM challenge_member cm INNER JOIN users member_user ON member_user.user_id = cm.user_id LEFT JOIN challenge_member_summary cms ON cms.member_id = cm.member_id LEFT JOIN challenge_monthly_result cmr ON cmr.member_id = cm.member_id AND cmr.result_month = #{resultMonth} WHERE cm.group_id = #{groupId} AND member_user.is_withdrawn = FALSE ), ranked_members AS ( SELECT member_scores.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY mission_completion_count DESC, member_id ASC ) AS ranking_no, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY mission_completion_count ASC, member_id ASC ) AS ascending_row_no, COUNT(*) OVER () AS member_count FROM member_scores )

, highest_badges AS ( SELECT ub.user_id, b.mission_type AS highest_badge_type, b.grade AS highest_badge_grade, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ub.user_id ORDER BY b.required_completion_count DESC, FIELD(b.mission_type, 'SAFE', 'AGGRESSIVE'), ub.acquired_at ASC, ub.user_badge_id ASC ) AS badge_ranking_no FROM user_badge ub INNER JOIN badge b ON b.badge_id = ub.badge_id INNER JOIN ranked_members rm ON rm.user_id = ub.user_id AND rm.ranking_no <= 3 WHERE b.is_active = TRUE )
mapper.select: SELECT cg.group_id, cg.soldier_type, cg.enlistment_year, cg.enlistment_month FROM challenge_member cm INNER JOIN challenge_group cg ON cg.group_id = cm.group_id WHERE cm.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY cm.joined_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT rm.ranking_no, rm.member_count, u.nickname, u.profile_image, u.profile_source, rm.mission_completion_count, hb.highest_badge_type, hb.highest_badge_grade FROM ranked_members rm INNER JOIN users u ON u.user_id = rm.user_id LEFT JOIN highest_badges hb ON hb.user_id = rm.user_id AND hb.badge_ranking_no = 1 WHERE u.is_withdrawn = FALSE ORDER BY rm.ranking_no LIMIT 3
SELECT ranking_no, member_count, mission_completion_count FROM ranked_members WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT MAX(member_count) AS member_count, CAST(ROUND(AVG(mission_completion_count)) AS SIGNED) AS average_mission_completion_count, CAST( ROUND( AVG( CASE WHEN ascending_row_no <= CEILING(member_count * 0.25) THEN mission_completion_count END ) ) AS SIGNED ) AS bottom_quarter_average_mission_completion_count, MAX( CASE WHEN ranking_no = CEILING(member_count * 0.10) THEN mission_completion_count END ) AS top_ten_percent_threshold, MAX(updated_at) AS last_updated_at FROM ranked_members
